zh-CN.title: 广场支持评论与全屏看图
items: 发言支持评论，讨论集中在独立面板中
广场照片复用聊天同款全屏画廊，可左右切换
广场 Header 与其他核心 Tab 对齐，消息同步统一使用 sync-v2

en.title: Comments and full-screen photos arrive in the Square
items: Statements now support comments in a focused discussion panel
Square photos use the same swipeable full-screen gallery as chat
The Square header now matches core tabs and message sync uses sync-v2 only
